game.name: Golden Compass, The (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Young Lyra Belacqua, seeking to uncover the mysteries behind a string of child kidnappings, finds herself plunged into a conflict which shakes the very foundations of her world. With the help of her shape-shifting animal daemon Pan, and armored polar bear companion Iorek, her adventures take her from the rooftops of Oxford to the frozen wastes of the North.
